DIAGNOSIS READY: Intraventricular Hemorrhage (IVH) secondary to germinal matrix hemorrhage in a premature infant.

The cranial ultrasound confirms bleeding within the ventricles, which correlates with the history of low Apgar scores, chorioamnionitis, and the onset of seizures and lethargy in a 31-week preterm neonate.
